app-education-learning.summary: Applies research findings on spaced review, retrieval practice, prior knowledge and metacognition to classrooms and self-study, to improve learning.
app-education-learning.landmark: Bransford and colleagues, How People Learn, summarizes research on cognition, development and teaching

app-industrial-organizational.summary: Uses research on motivation, leadership, teams and personnel selection to improve work environments and organizational decisions.

app-health-psychology.summary: Studies the relationship between stress, behavior and chronic illness, and designs interventions for smoking cessation, medication adherence and pain management.
app-health-psychology.landmark: The American Psychological Association establishes its Health Psychology division (Division 38)

app-forensic.summary: Uses research on memory, judgment and motivation to evaluate eyewitness testimony, interrogation methods and sentencing decisions.
app-forensic.landmark: Münsterberg, On the Witness Stand, discusses the reliability of eyewitness testimony

app-human-factors.summary: Applies the regularities of perception, attention and memory to interface and product design, making products easier to use and less error-prone.
app-human-factors.landmark: Norman, The Design of Everyday Things, proposes design principles such as affordances and feedback

app-public-policy.summary: Uses research on heuristics, biases and default options to design public policies such as retirement saving and organ donation.
app-public-policy.landmark: Thaler and Sunstein, Nudge; the UK Behavioural Insights Team is founded in 2010

app-self-help.summary: Turns methods such as CBT into self-help books, apps and exercises for people who do not enter treatment. It also includes peer groups such as Alcoholics Anonymous. Some of these methods are supported by controlled trials.
app-self-help.landmark: Burns, Feeling Good: The New Mood Therapy, a self-help book based on cognitive therapy
